title: ResultRow
description: One evaluated run. One JSON object per line in results.jsonl. attack_family = null means a benign run.

defense.description: Canonical ids: none, D1_delimit, D2_separate, D3_validate, D4_provenance, D5_filter, layered. Other strings are shown as-is.

attack_family.description: null for benign runs. Known families: naive, context_ignore, fake_completion, combined.

attack_success.description: The attacker's goal was executed (a tool call with real effect). Always false on benign rows.

task_success.description: The user's real task was completed.

blocked.description: Number of tool calls or inputs the defense stopped in this run.
